dimensions.name: Industry alignment
dimensions.rubric: Strong: a sector I care about. Weak: a sector I avoid or feel neutral about.

dimensions.name: Role fit
dimensions.rubric: Strong: the daily work is what I want to do. Weak: mostly tasks I want to move away from.

dimensions.name: Background match
dimensions.rubric: Strong: I meet the requirements. Weak: missing several core requirements.

dimensions.name: Compensation fit
dimensions.rubric: Strong: at or above my target. Middle: a bit below. Weak: far below my target.

dimensions.name: Upside potential
dimensions.rubric: Strong: growing company, equity, room to rise. Weak: flat or shrinking.

dimensions.name: Growth and learning
dimensions.rubric: Strong: mentorship, new skills, stretch scope. Weak: repetitive work, no support.
